name: What can go wrong if a foreclosed property is painted too fast?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if a foreclosed property is painted too fast?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risk is painting over problems instead of fixing them first, which can lead to peeling, stains bleeding through, and poor adhesion. A careful contractor should check for moisture, damaged drywall, and surface contamination before applying primer or finish coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: If prep is rushed, paint can peel, stain can bleed through, and hidden damage may show up after the job is done.
